cohort.selection: fixed-seed 40 each en/zh-cn/ja from the consumed 500-row development cohort

decision_rule: This is a development probe, not a release gate. Keep thinking mode only if it materially improves exact post-type sets without contract-validity or budget regression; any selected candidate must still pass a fresh unseen final cohort under the unchanged preregistered floors.
global_stop: The transport refuses request seven and reserves worst-case bytes and output tokens before every call. Capacity cannot transfer to another lane, retry, prompt, cohort, or provider.
reason: The first unseen 700-row gate had full schema coverage and strong micro F1 but missed exact post-type sets because the non-thinking candidate omitted supported secondary labels. DeepSeek documents thinking mode as an accuracy aid for the same Flash model. This bounded consumed-development probe isolates that inference setting before any prompt or final-cohort change.
